_comment: Lunar-style in-game features. The HUD, zoom, freelook, motion blur and other client modules are done by Shadow Client's built-in mod (Shadow Menu, client-mod/); suiteProvides lists them. Optional add-ons (minimap, world map, old animations) come from existing Fabric mods on Modrinth; availability per Minecraft version is always checked live. 'inPack' = part of the one-click pack (empty: everything it had is built in now). 'coveredBySuite' = Shadow Menu already offers this feature (installing both duplicates HUD elements/keybinds). 'legacy' = a mod Shadow Menu replaced; never offered, only reported when a profile still has it.

features.name: Lunar-style HUD & PvP suite
features.summary: Shadow Client used this mod for its HUD and client modules before Shadow Menu 2.0 did them itself.
features.note: Not needed any more: Shadow Menu has the HUD, zoom, freelook and the rest built in. Keeping both shows HUD elements twice and binds the same keys.

features.name: Mod menu
features.summary: Adds a Mods button to the title and pause screens to open every mod's settings in game.
features.note: Not needed any more: Shadow Client's menu has its own mod list (Right Shift → Mods, or Mods on the title screen).

features.name: Chat heads
features.summary: Shows the sender's head next to each chat message.
features.note: Not needed any more: Shadow Menu shows chat heads itself (Chat Heads module, on by default).

features.name: Saturation display
features.summary: Shows hunger saturation and how much food will restore on the hunger bar.
features.note: Not needed any more: Shadow Menu has its own Saturation Display (on by default).

features.name: Ping in tab list
features.summary: Shows every player's ping as a number in the tab list.
features.note: Not needed any more: Shadow Menu shows ping numbers in the tab list itself (Ping in Tab, on by default).

features.name: Zoom
features.summary: Smooth, configurable zoom key (default C).
features.note: Not needed: Shadow Menu has zoom built in (C). Keeping both binds the same key.

features.name: Armor status
features.summary: Armor and held-item durability on screen.
features.note: Not needed: Shadow Menu has an Armor Status HUD module.

features.name: Keystrokes & CPS
features.summary: WASD/mouse keystroke display with clicks per second.
features.note: Not needed: Shadow Menu has Keystrokes and CPS HUD modules.

features.name: Dynamic crosshair
features.summary: Crosshair changes style depending on what you can do (attack, place, use).
features.note: Not needed: Shadow Menu has a Custom Crosshair module.

features.name: Hit color
features.summary: Custom colour on entities when they are hit.
features.note: Not needed: Shadow Menu has a Hit Color module.

features.name: 1.7 / 1.8 animations
features.summary: Classic sword-block, item and swing animations like old PvP clients.

features.name: Freelook
features.summary: Look around without turning your player.
features.note: Not needed: Shadow Menu has freelook built in (V). Keeping both binds the same key.

features.name: Fullbright
features.summary: Toggle full brightness or night vision with a key.
features.note: Not needed: Shadow Menu has a Fullbright module.

features.name: Motion blur
features.summary: Lunar-style motion blur. Costs some FPS.
features.note: Not needed: Shadow Menu has Motion Blur built in.

features.name: Block outline
features.summary: Custom colour and thickness for the block selection outline.
features.note: Not needed: Shadow Menu has a Block Outline module.

features.name: Time & weather changer
features.summary: Client-side time of day and weather (only you see it).
features.note: Not needed: Shadow Menu has Time Changer and No Rain modules.

features.name: Toggle sprint status
features.summary: Shows on screen whether you are sprinting/sneaking (pairs with vanilla toggle sprint).
features.note: Not needed: Shadow Menu has a Sprint Status HUD module.

features.name: Minimap & waypoints
features.summary: Minimap with waypoints.
features.note: Its entity radar is not allowed on some servers; servers can turn it off.

features.name: World map
features.summary: Full-screen map of explored terrain (pairs with the minimap).

features.name: Screenshot to clipboard
features.summary: F2 screenshots are also copied to the clipboard, ready to paste.
features.note: Not needed: Shadow Menu has Copy Screenshots built in.

features.name: Custom main menu
features.summary: Shadow Client used FancyMenu for its Lunar-style title screen before Shadow Menu 2.0 drew its own.
features.note: Not needed for the title screen any more: Shadow Client's own title screen is built in and always shown.
